# Undeclared Note

This file exists on disk but is NOT declared in sample-hazards's
module.json `files`. The README links to it anyway (mirroring
dreaming/README.md's real link to an undeclared docs/ file), so the
relative-reference rewrite must still resolve it to a pinned-SHA GitHub
blob URL rather than leaving a dead relative link or a 404 to the site's
own (declared-files-only) raw endpoints.
